input.sha256_scope: No image input beyond a zero-filled shape. The six scenarios are the same synthetic specs as classic-v1-layout-assembly; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.
input.provenance: Authored in tools/capture_markdown_v2_oracle.py, importing the specs from tools/capture_layout_assembly_oracle.py.

reference_paths: paddlex 3.7.2: inference/common/result/converter/markdown_format_funcs.py build_handle_funcs_dict and the pretty-mode HTML helpers
upstream.capture_method: Each scenario ran the executed post-model chain (standardized_data, get_layout_parsing_objects, sort_layout_parsing_blocks, the order_index tail) and was wrapped in a real LayoutParsingResultV2; _to_markdown was executed for pretty=True and pretty=False under this port's supported model settings (table recognition on, formula/seal/chart off, default markdown_ignore_labels). Recorded per variant: the Markdown text, the page continuation flags, and the collected image-path keys.
upstream.environment: python 3.12, paddlex 3.7.2, numpy 2.x, opencv-contrib-python 5.x (IO backend only)

limitations: Model settings are fixed to this port's supported mode; the use_table_recognition=False image fallback for table labels is implemented but not captured, since the port always runs with table recognition available.
markdown_images values are PIL crops upstream; the port records and compares the path keys only.
imgs_in_doc is empty: the pipeline-level extra image list belongs to the API slice.
